name: plugin_release_rkey
description: Content-derived release rkey (docs/PLUGIN_ARCHITECTURE.md §5): rkey = lowercase base32 (RFC 4648, no padding) of the SHA-256 digest inside a CIDv1 (multibase 'b', dag-cbor 0x71, sha2-256 0x12/32). The CID here wraps SHA-256("plugin release vector body v1" UTF-8). releaseRkeyFromCid(cid) must equal the frozen rkey; isValidReleaseRkey must accept it and reject any tampered variant. 52 chars, rkey-safe charset. Consumed by __tests__/plugin_vectors.test.ts.
